items.text: I'm looking for some advice on skincare routines for my age group. I've been noticing some fine lines and wrinkles lately, and I want to start taking better care of my skin. By the way, my friend Rachel's getting married next year, and it's got me thinking about my own life goals.
items.why: States Rachel is getting married next year, anchoring the timing of the event.

items.text: I'm 32, so I'm in my 30s. I'd say my skin type is normal, but it's been looking a bit dull lately. My main concerns are fine lines and wrinkles, especially around my eyes. I'm open to trying out different products, but I'd prefer something not too expensive.
items.why: User’s current age is given as 32, needed to compute how many years old the user will be at Rachel’s wedding.

I've been thinking about going back to school to pursue a master's degree, and I want to stay competitive in my industry.
